howItWorks.subtitle: Three simple steps between you and your next reward.
howItWorks.step1Body: Discover surveys that match your profile and interests.
howItWorks.step2Body: Answer questions honestly and completely, at your own pace.
howItWorks.step3Body: Earn SAR for every completed survey — paid straight to your balance.

earn.subtitle: Answer surveys. Share your opinion. Get paid.

marketplace.title: A marketplace of real opportunities

why.title: Why Survpay
why.subtitle: Built for trust, speed, and fairness — on both sides of the marketplace.
why.card1Body: Rewards land in your balance the moment you finish — most withdrawals clear within 1-3 business days.
why.card2Body: See the reward and time estimate before you ever start a survey.
why.card3Body: Your personal data is never sold. Companies only see aggregated, anonymized results.
why.card4Body: Attention checks and fraud detection keep the marketplace fair for everyone.

testimonials.title: Loved by respondents and researchers alike
testimonials.t1Quote: I fill a couple of surveys during my commute and cash out to STC Pay every week. It's genuinely simple.
testimonials.t2Quote: We used to wait weeks for consumer panels. With Survpay we had 1,000 quality responses in three days.
testimonials.t2Role: Head of Research, Nova Retail Group
testimonials.t3Quote: The targeting is precise and the analytics dashboard saves my team hours every week.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Yes. Creating a participant account is completely free — you only ever earn, never pay.
faq.a2: Once your available balance reaches SAR 50, you can withdraw via bank transfer or STC Pay.
faq.q3: How are surveys matched to me?
faq.a3: Companies target surveys by demographics like age, city, income, and interests. The more complete your profile, the more surveys you'll see.
faq.a4: We monitor completion speed, attention-check questions, and behavioral patterns, and our team reviews flagged activity before rewards are finalized.
faq.q5: How much does it cost for companies?
faq.a5: Companies pay per completed response, based on survey length and audience targeting. Pricing is shown before you launch.

helpPage.title: Help & Support
helpPage.subtitle: Answers to common questions, and how to reach us.
helpPage.contactBody: Our support team typically replies within a few hours.
helpPage.q1: When can I withdraw my earnings?
helpPage.a1: Once your available balance reaches SAR 50, you can request a withdrawal from the Withdraw page.
helpPage.q2: Why don't I see many surveys?
helpPage.a2: Surveys are matched to your demographic profile. Completing your profile unlocks more opportunities.
helpPage.q3: How long does a withdrawal take?
helpPage.a3: Most withdrawals are processed within 1-3 business days after a quick verification step.
helpPage.q4: What happens if I fail an attention check?
helpPage.a4: Occasional attention-check questions help us keep the marketplace fair. Repeated failures may flag your account for review.
